entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • HR fails when requesting an intermediate empty update #79898
  • Roslyn compiles C#14 extension members with incorrect nullability constraints metadata #79896
  • Consider turning on analyzer/generator time reporting by default #79895
  • Roslyn hits "unreachable" exception when processing type forward to a class containing an extension group #79894
  • Add warning for the reserved route parameter names in ASP.NET routes #79893
    Backlog

Closed

  • Correct the preview experience for `Implement Using Copilot` #77572
    18.0
  • Collection initializers can leak refs #75802
    Next
  • Escape analysis ignores local passed by reference to interpolated string handler `AppendFormatted()` method #63306
    Next
  • Grammars for all C# versions #79870

PullRequests

Created

  • Support forwarding types that have extensions #79901
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: address some follow-ups related to `using` directives #79890
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

Merged

  • Block ENC for extension blocks #79883
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode, Next
  • Upgrade servicehub.client to fix test source discovery #79899
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #79889
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'main-vs-deps' #79892
    Next
  • [release/dev17.12] Update dependencies to ensure coherency #79852
  • [release/dev17.14] Disable incremental binary analysis to workaround duplicate VSSetup artifacts #79897
  • Fix ref safety of implicit calls that might capture refs in the receiver #76657
    Area-Compilers, untriaged, Feature - Ref Fields, Next
  • Update package restore error message. #79876
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • EnC: Set name and flags of deleted definitions #79764
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: Address follow-ups related to collection expressions #79877
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Propagate `params` to lambdas and local functions #79880
    Area-Compilers
  • Avoid crash from Script class instantiation #79879
    Area-Compilers
